summary: An on/off switch for a single setting, with its label, description and error beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and its accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner input. Names the setting and does not change with the state (APG).

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the setting.

description.note: Help text under the label, in the accessible description.

error.note: Error message under the label. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

size.note: Track and thumb size: default is a 32x20 track with a 16px thumb, sm a 24x16 track with a 12px thumb. The label text keeps its size. Maps to the size vocabulary as medium and small (spec/api.json alias).

value.note: Submitted with the form while the switch is on; nothing is submitted while off (native checkbox semantics).

checked.note: On or off. Not reflected: the attribute is the default that form reset restores (like native defaultChecked).

required.note: Native required: the switch must be on for the form to submit (valueMissing while off). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled: not focusable, not toggleable, not submitted, dimmed. A <fieldset disabled> ancestor has the same effect without changing this attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: the track in the first column; label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.notes: Pill-shaped track; its fill shows the state together with the thumb position. Holds the native input and the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, transparent and covering the track; receives focus, Space, the click and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob, inset 2px from the track edge; sits at the start when off and at the end when on (mirrored under :dir(rtl)). Decorative, pointer-events none.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles the switch.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle by the user. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed by the user. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). Not fired when checked is set from script or by form reset.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the end; position, not color alone, shows the state (WCAG 1.4.1).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt
invalid.note: Track border in destructive; the error text is the primary cue.

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a <fieldset disabled> ancestor (:host(:disabled))
disabled.note: Track and label dimmed, not-allowed cursor.

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins (ElementInternals): setFormValue(value) only while on, null while off; validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing, error -> customError); formResetCallback restores the default checked state from the attribute; formStateRestoreCallback restores checked; a disabled host or <fieldset disabled> ancestor is not submitted and cannot be toggled (isDisabled); <label for> pointing at the host toggles it.

accessibility.targetSize: Default track 32x20, sm 24x16; the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception. hide-label switches must sit with at least 24px of clear space.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px solid ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the inner input has no form owner in the shadow root, SB-0009). Does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; checked is exposed as aria-checked true/false by the browser (never mixed)
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required (exposed as required); the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
only aria-label is forwarded from the host (SB-0009)
announcements: state change is announced by the screen reader from the switch role (on/off)
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: The effect of the setting needs explaining
A list of settings in a form
useCases.use: one sb-switch per setting, each with its own name

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("Enabled" / "Disabled")
antiPatterns.why: The APG switch pattern keeps the label constant; the role already announces on or off
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting, such as "Notifications"

antiPatterns.why: A switch has only on and off (APG); it cannot show mixed

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch is a single on/off choice

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field and Label around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside

drift.contract: default track 32x20 and sm 24x16 (size.switch.* tokens), thumb 16px / 12px with a 2px inset
drift.realization: shadcn default track is 32x18.4 with a 1px transparent border, sm 24x14

drift.contract: color.background in every mode and state
drift.realization: shadcn dark uses foreground (off) and primary-foreground (on)
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes: APG switch pattern for role and keyboard, the visual reference for look and sizes, form behavior from the form-associated-controls rule.

openQuestions.question: Which native element carries the role: <input type=checkbox role=switch>, <button role=switch aria-checked>, or the new <input type=checkbox switch> attribute?
openQuestions.recommendation: <input type=checkbox role=switch>: native focus, Space, required/valueMissing, disabled and label activation for free, and it reuses FormAssociated + NativeControl like Checkbox (SB-0007 native first). A button needs hand-built validity; the switch attribute is not supported across browsers.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional) or submit the form?
openQuestions.recommendation: Submit the form, like native checkboxes and sb-checkbox (SB-0009). Space toggles.
openQuestions.answer: Enter submits the form and does not toggle, as recommended.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.recommendation: No: the attribute is the default restored by form reset (native defaultChecked), as in Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean for a switch?
openQuestions.recommendation: Native meaning: it must be on (valueMissing while off), with the asterisk; recommend it only for consent-like settings, and say so in the docs.

openQuestions.question: Which two sizes, and with which names?
openQuestions.recommendation: The visual reference's default and sm, already mapped to medium and small by the size alias in spec/api.json; dimensions from the existing size.switch.* and space.switch.inset tokens.

openQuestions.question: Where does the label sit, and is there an option to put it before the switch?
openQuestions.recommendation: After the switch (end side), as in Checkbox and the visual reference's examples; no position option until a product needs one (YAGNI).
openQuestions.answer: Label after the switch, no option, as recommended.

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and is there a hide-label option?
openQuestions.recommendation: Required, with hide-label keeping it as the accessible name (same as Checkbox and Input).

openQuestions.question: Thumb color in dark mode: the visual reference's foreground/primary-foreground pair or one token?
openQuestions.recommendation: One token, color.background, in every mode: it meets 3:1 on both track colors in light and dark (checked by T6) and keeps one design property; recorded as drift.

openQuestions.question: Does the thumb animate?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes, a 150ms transform transition, removed under prefers-reduced-motion (WCAG 2.3.3).
openQuestions.answer: Animates, off under reduced motion, as recommended.
